<!-- Generated by scripts/gensite. Do not edit; run mise run docs. -->

| Kind | Reads |
|---|---|
| `gh-release` | The GitHub release body of each version. |
| `changelog-file` | The section of each version in a changelog file of the tool's repository. Each file is fetched and parsed once per digest. |
| `structured-json` | One JSON document per version, from a repository file or an allowed URL, turned into a list grouped by a heading field. |
| `web-doc` | Release notes on an allowed web page. With an anchor, each version gets the element with its id; without one, a page holds a whole release line. |
| `upgrade-guide` | A whole upgrade document, attached to the first version of each new release line in the range: one per minor when the template has {minor} or {prev_minor}, else one per major. |
| `upgrade-notes` | The section under a heading such as Urgent Upgrade Notes inside each version's section of the changelog-file source, so its entries count as upgrade notes. |
